description: This file defines an internal utility class for managing collections of observers, supporting subscription, unsubscription, notification, and expiration of observers within the Orleans distributed framework.

classes.name: ObserverManager<TObserver>
classes.description: A specialized observer manager that inherits from a generic implementation, simplifying management for a specific observer type.

classes.name: ObserverManager<TIdentity, TObserver>
classes.description: A generic class that maintains a collection of observers identified by a unique key, with support for thread-safe notification and expiration.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Adds or updates an observer with a specific identity, renewing its subscription.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes an observer based on its identity.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Invokes a notification callback on all active observers, supporting expiration and filtering.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all observers from the collection.

methods.name: ClearExpired
methods.description: Removes all expired observers based on expiration time.
